description: The openai-compatible family's default record: what the loop did for this family before it read a record, so a host that supplies it changes nothing. No window or output cap (the budget table's stand), native and parallel tool calls with nothing extra sent, reasoning_effort for the tier, the reasoning member read as the SDK reads it, a streamed answer asked for (a whole one is still re-framed), the served schema as served. No vision: an endpoint of this family is not known to take images, so an image reaches it as the host's text rendering until its own record says otherwise.
